2026-11-22.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Fixed lambs getting stuck and failing to follow a sprinting player when led.
Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.
Monument guard NPCs now spread out, scale with monument size, and can stand on any floor.

Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.

2026-11-21.summary:
### NPC & AI
- Fixed lambs getting stuck and failing to follow a sprinting player when led.
- Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.

### Monuments & World
- Monument guard NPCs now spread out, scale with monument size, and can stand on any floor.
- Raid maps now spawn only whitelisted monuments, with each tier‑1 monument appearing once per map.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.
- Bank balance is now always displayed on the Outpost screen for continuous fund monitoring.

items.text: Added the M79 grenade launcher, a new explosive weapon for players.
Introduced a convar to enable modern sprint strafing, allowing more fluid movement while sprinting.

Shoulder camera now responds more dynamically: it follows forward/backward and vertical movement without drift, adjusts distance when crouched, leans with speed changes, reacts to melee hits, and briefly pauses after hard landings.
Vehicle and mount chase cameras now have distinct profiles with smooth easing when mounting or dismounting and a configurable range for tuning.
Spectator view no longer experiences slow‑motion; it now correctly follows the target without lag.
Train tunnel rail links are prevented from spawning too close to lakes, eliminating blocked tunnels and terrain carving issues.

Fixed multiple base occlusion and deployable visibility issues, including foundation placement errors, deployables on roofs and seams, dropbox visibility through walls, and placement problems in tall rooms.

Extraction improvements: failed jobs now return cargo, ground rope physics and cable tool behavior are fixed, bow handling is steadier, and walking animations are smoother with hip turning on diagonals.
Raid entry and exit now feature a black screen with a hatch sound, and returning home after a raid places you beside the deploy point behind the summary screen.
Scrap is now kept in a central bank at the hub rather than in individual stash slots.
Engine sounds now correctly play for pooled vehicles, fixing silent or overlapping audio.

2026-11-20.summary:
### Gameplay & Combat
- Added the M79 grenade launcher, a new explosive weapon for players.
- Introduced a convar to enable modern sprint strafing, allowing more fluid movement while sprinting.

### Movement & Camera
- Shoulder camera now responds more dynamically: it follows forward/backward and vertical movement without drift, adjusts distance when crouched, leans with speed changes, reacts to melee hits, and briefly pauses after hard landings.
- Vehicle and mount chase cameras now have distinct profiles with smooth easing when mounting or dismounting and a configurable range for tuning.
- Spectator view no longer experiences slow‑motion; it now correctly follows the target without lag.

### World & Environment
- Train tunnel rail links are prevented from spawning too close to lakes, eliminating blocked tunnels and terrain carving issues.
- Fixed multiple base occlusion and deployable visibility issues, including foundation placement errors, deployables on roofs and seams, dropbox visibility through walls, and placement problems in tall rooms.

### Extraction & Raid Flow
- Extraction improvements: failed jobs now return cargo, ground rope physics and cable tool behavior are fixed, bow handling is steadier, and walking animations are smoother with hip turning on diagonals.
- Raid entry and exit now feature a black screen with a hatch sound, and returning home after a raid places you beside the deploy point behind the summary screen.

### Economy & Storage
- Scrap is now kept in a central bank at the hub rather than in individual stash slots.

### Audio & Immersion
- Engine sounds now correctly play for pooled vehicles, fixing silent or overlapping audio.
